_doc: Ground truth for tools/bench/replay.py. Three lists, scored apart:
labels: one entry per issue a reviewer raised on an archived attempt (the headline recall). id: the reviewer's id (v1: the FINDINGS id);
findings_id: the FINDINGS row; severity (blocker 3, major 2, minor 1 in the weighted recall); tool_catchable: the reviewer's flag
(v1: FINDINGS 'Tool that catches it'); process: true = not a design defect, out of every denominator; credit_scope: 'rows' = the
designer config's row for it was written from the review, so it counts in rows scope only; source: FINDINGS line or HW/... review
file (HW = ~/code-stuff/mmlauncher/mm-launcher/mm-launch-hw); judgment: where this is a call.
printability: tool findings no reviewer raised (the layer check's support misses, v1 and v2 alike), one entry per finding with the
attempts it is on; scored once per finding (worst status over those attempts) in its own score, never in reviewer recall.
confirmed_by: 'print YYYY-MM-DD' when a real print confirmed it; print_evidence: [{date: YYYY-MM-DD, by: who printed and looked,
printed: what was printed (parts, settings, supports), result: fail | pass | partial, observed: what was seen, action: what it
needs (optional), photo: path (optional)}]. Add an entry per print, on any finding or label.
known_true_positives: planted overlay rows and exploratory review rows: real fails that credit nothing and are not false fails.
locators (every list): any of {check, objects, kind, region?, partial?}. A report line 'check: message' (cadcheck fail/warn
lists, 'printcheck: <stl>: ...', 'bom: BAD ...') matches when it starts with check, names every object (whole token; * ? [..]
glob over a family; a named row or test when the line names no object), and matches the kind regex (the defect, never a
measured number) and the region regex (where on the part, when the part has other findings). partial: true = the line covers
part of the issue (a coverage warn, a sub-point): status 'partial', not caught. locators null: no check names it.
`replay.py lint` rejects a top-level | in a regex, check '*', a locator with no object and a number pinned in kind.
